```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [created]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish-ppa:
    runs-on: ubuntu-20.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Free disk space
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
        with:
          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: true
          docker-images: true
          preinstalled-runtimes: true
          tool-cache: true
          swap-storage: true

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential debhelper devscripts dh-make libssl-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev

      - name: Build Debian package
        run: |
          # Create necessary directories
          mkdir -p target/debian
          
          # Build the project
          cargo build --release
          
          # Create debian package structure
          mkdir -p target/debian/usr/bin
          cp target/release/mise target/debian/usr/bin/
          
          # Create control file
          cat > target/debian/DEBIAN/control << EOF
          Package: mise
          Version: $(grep version Cargo.toml | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f2)
          Section: utils
          Priority: optional
          Architecture: amd64
          Depends: libc6 (>= 2.27)
          Maintainer: JDX <jdx@users.noreply.github.com>
          Description: mise - The universal package manager
           Mise is a tool for managing programming language versions.
          EOF

      - name: Create source package
        run: |
          cd target/debian
          dpkg-deb --build .
          cd ..

      - name: Setup GPG
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg@v6
        with:
          gpg_private_key: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          passphrase: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}

      - name: Publish to Launchpad
        env:
          LP_USER: ${{ secrets.LP_USER }}
          LP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.LP_PASSWORD }}
          GPG_KEY: ${{ secrets.GPG_KEY_ID }}
        run: |
          # Install launchpadlib
          sudo apt-get install -y python3-launchpadlib
          
          # Create source package
          dpkg-source -b .
          
          # Upload to Launchpad
          dput ppa:${LP_USER}/mise *.changes
```
